_meta._note: Server-side PDPA values that game rules and copy read. Keys sit at the top level so the names match the docs exactly (privacy.positionLogTtl_s, privacy.minAge_yr). On-device export and logging rules live in config/app/privacy.json (tech-lead, P1-H05); do not duplicate values between the two files. Loaders namespace by path: balance.privacy vs app.privacy. Changing any value here needs HUMAN approval (PDPA sign-off is HUMAN only, protocol section 5); these are not tuning values

_source.minAge_yr: GDD > ความปลอดภัยผู้เล่นและ PDPA > อายุขั้นต่ำ 15 ปี; pillars 6.1 (จุดตรวจอายุ 15+); flow F03 A step 4 (A-P1-F03-T16-6 เสนอ key privacy.minAge_yr)
_source.minAgeComparison: GDD > อายุขั้นต่ำ 15 ปี (15 ปีผ่าน)

_note: positionLogTtl_s: 86400 s = 24 h, measured from the sample timestamp ts; older rows are deleted, not archived. Copy shows it through a formatted duration variable, never a typed number. dungeons.json#offlineEvidence.maxOfflineEvidenceAge_s (1800) is far below the TTL, so late-uploaded samples still fit the retention window. minAge_yr: age >= 15 passes; the player picks an age band or birth year from a list (no typing). Copy variable {minAge} reads this value. GDD notes Thai law treats under-20 as minors; the consent requirement for ages 15-19 is a HUMAN legal question, not a config default
